thread:
Samira N: Heads-up — I'm opening a docs PR to add q4_0/q8_0 rows to the Hyperion-8b model card, plus a couple of SDK snippets and a short migration note. Current card only shows fp16 numbers and a dead bench anchor.

Tom H: Drop the PR link? I'll take bench numbers and a quick table.

Samira N: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5299. Plan: update limits table, include Python + CLI snippets showing explicit variant and KV cache toggle, and add a note about Hosted vs Dedicated/Private fallback semantics.

Ravi K: Bench summary (internal): Hyperion-8b-q4_0 on A100-40 seq512: peak ~4.3GB with KV cache, ~5.6GB without; q8_0 slightly higher. Long-context fp16 variant (seq1024) ~10.2GB. I'll paste a compact table.

Ravi K: ```
Model                    seq512   w/KV-cache   w/o-KV
hyperion-8b-q4_0         4.3GB     4.3GB        5.6GB
hyperion-8b-q8_0         4.8GB     4.8GB        6.1GB
hyperion-8b-long-fp16    10.2GB    10.2GB       12.4GB
```

Tom H: Nice. For snippets: Python to show explicit model variant + fallback ordering, and a CLI example for runtime flags. Remember to use "KV cache" casing and call out variability by driver/sequence/batch.

Samira N: Draft Python snippet for the card: 

```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
  model="hyperion-8b-q4_0",
  options={"kv_cache": True, "fallback": ["hyperion-8b-fp16"]},
  max_tokens=256
)
print(resp.text)
```

Samira N: CLI example: `redwood-runtime serve --model hyperion-8b-q4_0 --kv-cache=true --quant q4_0`

Tom H: Add migration blurb: "If you pinned `hyperion-8b:latest`, pin `hyperion-8b@v2` or explicitly request `hyperion-8b-q4_0` to opt into quantized variants." Also a short sentence: "Hosted routing may select a compatible fp16 variant under capacity constraints; explicit fallback ordering is honored on Dedicated/Private deployments."

Ravi K: One small nit: link to internal bench run https://bench.internal/redwood/hyperion-8b-quant-2026. Also include the usual caveat: "Numbers are approximate and may vary by driver, runtime configuration, sequence length, and batch size."

ci-bot: ci/build 5299 — docs lint passed, linkcheck reported a broken internal anchor which Samira fixed in the last commit.

Tom H: LGTM after nits. Will merge once CI green and the limits-refactor in #5280 is reconciled.

Samira N: Pushed fixes and updated wording. Marked @Tom H @Ravi K for review.

ci-bot: ci/build 5299 — all checks passed. Merged by Tom H.

Samira N: Thanks team! I'll follow up next sprint with a small notebook plotting memory vs sequence length for q4_0 vs fp16 and link it from the card.
